heading_gate: Every original segment must be >=0.02m as in the original read_inputs; no surrogate first-node heading
on_invalid_initial_heading: No optimizer or rigid alignment; report NOT_RUN_INVALID_INITIAL_HEADING. Evaluate only RAW, UNCHANGED-B-LOCAL, STOP.
pre_raw_gate: Original PD, fixed B52, native XY and RAW rollout checked against frozen expected values; prior validated trace hash/status is available. No future prediction.
post_gate_trace_validation: After a solve or terminal heading rejection, compare only FRESH52 execution ticks1016..1032. Trace is never passed to a solver.
horizon_note: 16 ticks fixed a priori; no FRESH53 event/prediction or later collision outcome read
stop: Literal zero command, no fabricated waypoint/trajectory/yaw; trivial reference only
outputs: small JSON/CSV and one comparison XY figure
